summary: Agora, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. Total revenues were $37.7 million, up 13.5% YoY, with gross margin of 63.4%, net income of $1.1 million, and cash of $366.1 million. The press release announced a new conversational AI product, Agent Studio. There are no terms, parties, or structural changes related to mergers, acquisitions, activist campaigns, spin-offs, or other special situations. This is a routine quarterly earnings release, not triggering any special-situation classification.
